name: @finlayjn/asyncapi-swift-ws-template
description: AsyncAPI Generator template for Swift 6 WebSocket clients

scripts.test: node --test test/generate.test.js test/generate-new-features.test.js test/allof-outgoing.test.js test/url-injection.test.js test/unions-and-nesting.test.js test/library.test.js test/shared-helpers.test.js test/edge-cases.test.js && node --test test/compile.test.js test/swift-runtime.test.js
scripts.test:static: node --test test/generate.test.js test/generate-new-features.test.js test/allof-outgoing.test.js test/url-injection.test.js test/unions-and-nesting.test.js test/library.test.js test/shared-helpers.test.js test/edge-cases.test.js

server.description: Name of the server from the AsyncAPI spec to use for connection URL.

packageName.description: Name for the generated Swift Package. Defaults to the spec title in PascalCase.

msgpackFormat.description: Wire layout for msgpack messages: 'map' (keyed dictionaries) or 'array' (positional). Only applies when serialization=msgpack.

typePrefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to all generated Swift type names (e.g. 'OMN' produces OMNPlaceOrder, OMNWebSocketClient, etc.).

formatter.description: Shell command to format generated Swift files. Receives file paths as arguments (e.g. 'swift-format -i', 'swiftformat').

allowNameCollisions.description: When 'true', allow multiple messages to share the same 'name' field. Colliding messages are disambiguated using their component key (e.g. order_preview_response). Default is 'false', which treats collisions as a generation error.

perspective.description: Perspective from which the AsyncAPI spec is written: 'server' (default, standard AsyncAPI v3 — send means server-to-client) or 'client' (send means client-to-server).

openEnums.description: When 'true', every generated enum gets an `unknown(RawValue)` case, so values the spec doesn't list decode instead of failing the message. Unknown values are reported to an optional handler passed to the serializer, and encode back unchanged.

helpersModule.description: Name of a Swift module that provides the shared helpers (lib/helpers.js: the generic WebSocket client, its configuration and policies, the serializers, UnknownEnumValue). When set, only Sources/ is generated, the client imports that module, and its old names become type aliases. Unset (the default), every helper is generated inline with the type prefix.

messagePackHelpersModule.description: With helpersModule and MessagePack serialization: the module that provides MessagePackSerializer (lib/helpers.js generateMessagePackHelpers).

undecodableMessages.description: How to handle messages that fail to decode: 'yield' (default — adds an undecodable case to IncomingMessage so consumers can inspect the raw data and error) or 'drop' (silently skip malformed messages).
